events.title: Barbican Conservatory Plant Adoption
events.summary: The third announced free plant-adoption event offers propagated cuttings before the Conservatory's restoration closure; booking details are published by the Barbican.

events.title: Kimberly Akimbo
events.summary: Run extended to 14 November 2026. Evenings 19:30; Thursday/Saturday matinees 14:30. Select a session for live seat availability and prices.

events.title: Heath Info Hut open day
events.venue: Heath Info Hut, near Parliament Hill tennis courts
events.summary: 10:00–14:00. Visit the information hut for Heath maps, nature sheets and information about activities. The official listing invites visitors to drop in.

events.title: Kenwood Dairy open day
events.summary: 11:00–15:00. The Nature Interpretation Centre opens for visitors to see wildlife specimens and displays, pick up leaflets and learn about activities on the Heath.

events.title: Highgate Wood - Tree ID Walk
events.venue: Information hut next to the café
events.summary: 11:30–13:00. Free ranger-led walk, with no advance booking required. Meet at the information hut. The City lists the October 24 autumn walk and October 31 tree-identification walk.

events.title: Litter pick
events.venue: Heath Info Hut, near Parliament Hill tennis courts
events.summary: 12:00–13:00. Drop-in litter pick around Parliament Hill. All welcome, equipment provided and no booking required; meet at the hut at the start.

events.title: Wild about Hampstead Heath
events.summary: 14:00–16:00. Free drop-in session with volunteer wildlife interpreters. Look for the Wild About Hampstead Heath bike; no booking required.

events.title: Highgate Wood Tree and Fungi Walk
events.venue: Information hut next to the café
events.summary: Free staff-led walk lasting approximately 1–1.5 hours. Meet at the information hut next to the café; no advance booking required.

events.title: Highgate Wood Winter Guided Walk
events.venue: Information hut next to the café
events.summary: Free staff-led walk lasting approximately 1–1.5 hours. Meet at the information hut next to the café; no advance booking required.

events.title: Yuko Mohri: In Concert
events.summary: Free installation of kinetic sculpture, light and sound using Barbican objects. Tuesday–Sunday 11:00–19:00; closed Mondays and 24–26 December. New Year’s Day hours are 12:00–20:00.

events.title: Spitalfields Arts Market
events.summary: Free entry to meet artists and browse paintings, prints, ceramics and photography. The official market programme confirms this three-day weekend.

events.title: Robert Ryman: The Real Thing
events.summary: More than 60 works; allow 90 minutes. Standard £20.50 including fee. Pay What You Can Thursday 17:00–20:00 and Friday 10:00–12:00. Closed Mondays and 24–26 December. Select a session through the official booking page.

events.title: 40 Objects, 40 Years
events.summary: Anniversary exhibition included in museum admission; adult £14.90 without donation. Wednesday–Sunday 10:30–17:00. Upstairs with no step-free access; drop-ins welcome. Session hours: 10:30–17:00.

events.title: Guildhall Art Gallery shortened opening
events.venue: Guildhall Art Gallery / London’s Roman Amphitheatre
events.summary: Gallery and Amphitheatre open 10:00–15:30. The upper Main Gallery closes at midday.

events.title: Guildhall Art Gallery later opening
events.venue: Guildhall Art Gallery / London’s Roman Amphitheatre
events.summary: Gallery and Amphitheatre open 11:00–17:00 rather than the normal earlier opening.

events.title: Guildhall Art Gallery and Amphitheatre closed
events.venue: Guildhall Art Gallery / London’s Roman Amphitheatre
events.summary: Both spaces closed all day; postpone gallery and Roman Amphitheatre visits.

events.title: Liz Larner: A hard line to bend
events.summary: Free exhibition, normally Wednesday–Sunday 11:00–18:00. Extra Frieze Week opening on Monday 12 and Tuesday 13 October, also 11:00–18:00. Level access and lifts available.

events.title: Spotlight on Medieval London
events.summary: Free independent display during normal opening: Monday 10:00–16:30, Tuesday 10:00–18:00, Wednesday 10:00–19:00, Thursday 10:00–16:30; selected Saturdays only. No History Card needed. The separately ticketed 13 October talk has not been included as bookable.

events.title: Bank of England Museum closes at 3pm
events.summary: Official planned early closure from 15:00. Arrange a free museum visit before this cutoff; individual admission normally needs no booking.

events.title: Hampstead in Print: Milein Cosman and her Circle
events.summary: Free exhibition. Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday 10:00–16:00, subject to house closures; Friday 23 October closes 13:00. First-floor gallery inaccessible to wheelchair users.

events.title: Guildhall Art Gallery and Amphitheatre closed
events.venue: Guildhall Art Gallery / London’s Roman Amphitheatre
events.summary: Both spaces closed all day in the current official special-closures notice. Postpone gallery and amphitheatre visits.

events.title: LNHS fungi walk — postponed to 6 November
events.summary: Postponed from Sunday 1 November to Friday 6 November; same 10:30 meeting outside Hampstead Heath Overground station. Register by email and await confirmation; bring lunch.

events.title: Concrete and Clay: Archiving the Barbican
events.summary: Free archive installation on the Mezzanine, Level G; includes a 1:22-scale model.

events.title: Dogstar
events.summary: Daisy Hall’s play downstairs; tickets advertised from £28. 31 October sold out; later performances show limited availability. Select a date in the booking system.

events.title: 1327 and the City of London
events.summary: Free display of charters, manuscripts and civic chronicles at Guildhall Art Gallery. Regular gallery hours 10am–5pm, last admission 4.45pm; special closures apply.

events.title: Kenwood autumn events consultation
events.summary: Old Kitchen consultation. RSVP to Kenwood.house@english-heritage.org.uk. East Lodge access from 18:00. Announcement says ends 20:00 but structured listing says 20:30; confirm with organiser.
